newsitem.title: USA: FAA fines FedEx over engine records.
newsitem.headline: FAA fines FedEx over engine records.

text.p: The Federal Aviation Administration said Tuesday it proposed a $187,500 penalty against Federal Express Corp for failing to properly maintain records for 21 aircraft engines.
The FAA said in a statement that an audit revealed that records for the 21 Pratt & Whitney JT8D engines were not contained in FedEx's computerized records management system.
Three of those 21 engines lacked documents to show compliance with airworthiness directives, the time of last required overhaul and status of life-limited parts.
FedEx had been given 10 days to respond to the proposed penalty, FAA said.
